title: Credits
content: The APSU GIS Center website is built with Astro and Tailwind CSS and maintained to support public-sector geospatial services, outreach, and regional collaboration.

list.item: Web framework and build tooling: Astro
Primary geospatial platform integrations: Esri ArcGIS
Typography resources provided through open-source font packages and APSU brand standards
Content, map links, and service descriptions are maintained by APSU GIS Center and supporting collaborators
